newsitem.title: USA: Allegheny Cty Auth, Pa., picks new bond syndicate.
newsitem.headline: Allegheny Cty Auth, Pa., picks new bond syndicate.

text.p: Allegheny County Sanitary Authority, Pa., said that it had picked four firms for a new bond syndicate that will sell about $180 million of issues to pay for sewer upgrades.

The new syndicate is comprised of Commonwealth Securities and Investments, which will sell 40 percent of the bonds, A.H. Williams & Co, which will market 30 percent of the bonds, and Arthurs, Lestrange & Co and Smith Barney, each of which will sell 15 percent of the bonds.
The plant upgrades are expected to begin July 1, 1997, the Authority said, in prepared remarks released on Friday.
A spokesman for the Authority was not immediately available to comment on when the bond sale is planned.
